data_deps.name: image_deblur_gopro
data_deps.description: Tiny fixed sets of blurry->sharp 64x64 image pairs for the deblur-* image-deblurring tasks, drawn from REAL photographs: the GoPro Large-Scale Blur Dataset (Nah, Kim & Lee, CVPR 2017), where the blurry frame is a genuine motion-averaged capture and the sharp frame a genuine high-speed capture of the SAME instant (both real photographs, pixel-aligned; author-hosted HF mirror snah/GOPRO_Large, streamed via remotezip -- no full-archive download). Full-resolution frames are tiled into 64x64 patches and bucketed by MEASURED blur/sharp tile PSNR into THREE real severity terciles (small/medium/large, mild->heavy real motion blur; each deblur task aggregates its score over these 3 settings). Every legacy severity-band code (rs/rm/rl, ms/mm/ml, hs/hm/hl, em/el) used by individual task scripts is an alias onto this one real ladder (see prepare_data.py _ALIAS). Train/val use GoPro's own disjoint-SCENE split (4 train + 4 test sequences staged), so held-out PSNR measures genuine cross-scene generalisation. Pre-staged raw frames may be pointed to via GOPRO_RAW_DIR for network-restricted hosts.
